explanation: The book states there is no monopole radiation (mass conservation) and no dipole radiation (momentum conservation), so the first non-vanishing contribution is the mass quadrupole moment Qⁱʲ. This contrasts with electromagnetism, where accelerating charges give leading dipole radiation. Octupole terms exist but are higher-order and subdominant.
